🧪  **glamsterdam-devnet@v8.0.0**: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases/tag/tests-glamsterdam-devnet@v8.0.0

EELS [branch](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/tree/tests-glamsterdam-devnet%40v8.0.0). PTAL at the release notes & test release [tracker](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/issues/3167) for the full scope!

**New in v8.0.0:**
- EIP-2780: transfer log cost folded into `TX_VALUE_COST`.
- EIP-8038: access-list costs are now the cold cost minus warm.
- EIP-8037: "regular gas" to "execution gas", terminology only.
